items.body: Karine Polwart has proved herself to be an exceptional talent as a singer and songwriter for many years, all the way back to her time with Malinky (the song �Thaney� was a revelation). As a solo artist she�s grown and continually expanded her horizons, coming now to Windblown , a project that began life seven years ago, when Polwart, along with sound designer and composer Pippa Murphy, was artist in residence at Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. The album, with its stage show and book, tells the story of the garden�s oldest specimen, a Sabal palm tree ( Sabal bermudana ), which was gently felled in 2021, and contained a surprise nobody had expected. The tree is the starting point. From there, imagination runs free. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan It�s an album of voice and piano (the outstanding, sympathetic Dave Milligan), and, for all its global outlook on connections, one that�s very rooted in Scotland. You can hear it on the opening track, �Hear The Rigging/Last In Line,� where the melody becomes a slow, aching lament that would sound completely natural on the pipes. The stripped-down sound gives the songs both crafted stateliness and real intimacy. Each one is an exhalation, a memory, a celebration and exploration, with recurring phrases in the words and music acting as touchstones � or even hooks; they certainly stick in the mind. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan In many ways, this is a modest album, with piano, voice and light, judicious soundscaping. It won�t overpower with noise. Yet at the same time, it�s epic, a look at history, at the flow and grandeur of nature, and the things we all carry within us. The music, and especially Polwart�s warm, compassionate voice, envelop the listener, and makes them a participant, not an observer, but a part of the journey and the history. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan The irony arrives at the end, when the venerable old tree is down, and seeds are examined. What people for two hundred years had believed to be a Sabal bermudana turns out to be something different, a Sabal mexicana � and one of the small plants fill grow where it�s forerunner once stood. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan Like music, plants keep to a different time � and this album/book/show give the tree the requiem it deserves, as well as hope for the future. items.body: Sudan Dudan is a Norwegian duo, Marit Karlberg and Anders Erik R�ine, who have released four albums over the last twenty years. On M�rke refrenger , their fifth, they are joined by Hans Hulb�kmo and Magnus Skavhaug Nergaard, contributing instrumentally and with the production. There are eight songs on the album with accompaniment principally led by acoustic guitar, augmented by fiddles, langeleik, lyre, jaws harp and more. The opening track, �Gard og grind� (�Fence and gate�) is a fine introduction to what is to come: finger-picked acoustic guitar, fiddle, bass and snare-drum played with brushes leading into the harmonized vocal, together creating an alluring sound drawing the listener in. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan The mood of the album, reflected in its title which translates as �Dark Refrains,� is not always dark, but most of the material, including the title track, certainly has a reflective quality. According to the press release �the lyrics smoulder with unease about the present and the future, while looking back to the myths and riddles of the past. They speak of the earth, the sun, the moon, stars and planets, of lost brothers, quarrelling sisters, loss and grief, of the power of imagination, and of the answers to the simplest and most difficult riddles.� The lyrics of all the songs, in Norwegian, are included in the sleeve notes and while a hasty online translation can aid with some understanding, the full meanings tend to remain cryptic, but there is a sense that words and music complement each other. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan For all its dark moodiness, M�rke refrenger does have its lighter moments. �Bagatelle� recalls and reinvents the melody of a well-known French song, adding some off-kilter harmonies, while �Rulleball� is more characteristically Norwegian, employing a vocal style known as tralling in which words are replaced by a vocalization of the melody, originally used to accompany dances when no instrument was available. No translation necessary there. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan The final track �Skriften p� veggen� (�the writing on the wall�) features, for the only time on the album, electric guitar. The sound is deep and twangy, shades of Duane Eddy or a David Lynch soundtrack and it works very well. All in all a fine, imaginatively conceived and beautifully produced record, available as a download or vinyl. Find the artists online. items.body:
According to its founder, Eugene Rodriguez, who also sings and plays on the record, Los Cenzontles is a �musical group and non-profit organization, which I founded over thirty years ago.�  As he continues in the album�s liner notes, the group �has a long history of producing projects exploring Mexico�s deep roots and our connections with various traditions that, so far, have included Irish, Louisiana Creole, Cuban, American cowboy, classical, pop, rock, and blues�, the latest of which is
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
. Los Cenzontles translates to the mockingbird, or, from its Aztec root word, the bird of four hundred voices. This is a fitting name for the range of musical diversity represented here.
With songs sung in Spanish, Hawaiian, and English, the concept traces back to the legacy of Mexican cowboys who travelled from California to the Hawaiian Islands to wrangle the long-horned cattle introduced there in the nineteenth century. They also brought the guitar. The 16 tracks feature old Hawaiian songs with new Spanish lyrics, old Mexican songs with new Hawaiian lyrics, new compositions, and traditional Americana. Yet it is an entirely cohesive musical package held together by dense arrangements of ukuleles, guitars, Mexican harp, and accordion.
Sonny Lim & David Hidalgo
Besides their distinctive voices, the headline artists Taj Mahal and David Hidalgo provide the gravitas and musicianship that their long and distinguished careers have earned. According to the liner notes, they were the catalysts behind the project and facilitated the choice of songs, arrangements, and played a range of instruments. On vocals they are joined by Hawaiian natives Gary Haleamau, Sheldeen Haleamau, Sonny Lim, and long-time Cenzontles member Fabiola Trujillo.
Deportee
To give a taste of the sessions, included before the traditional �Fishin� Blues� is Taj Mahal teaching the musicians how to play it. Sung by David Hildalgo,  the lovely �A Matter of Time� comes from the 1984 album
Will the Wolf Survive
by his most famous project, Los Lobos. Another standout for me, �Navegar� features a slack string guitar solo reminiscent of Duane Eddie and one of many tasty lap steel turns by Sonny Lim. Their interpretation of Woody Guthrie's �Deportee� moves into social commentary, highlighting the cruel realities of being a migrant worker in America.
Vaquero Paniolo
Recorded over five days, mostly live in one room at the Los Cenzontles headquarters in San Pablo, California, including the talents of some of their academy�s students, the recording has real spontaneity to it. Arrangements are stretched by improvisations, sometimes by several different instruments on a single tune. The project also represents a great spirit of cooperation and diversity of language, culture, age, and gender. It includes the inputs of musical legends, seasoned pros, and amateurs. The wonderfully rich and often stereotyped musical cultures of both Mexico and Hawaii are represented here with the authenticity of lived experience.
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
is a worthy addition to Los Cenzontles� important work. Quoting Rodriguez again, �Culture is a fabric within which we are all woven.�

items.body:
The musical partnership between Kalaniemi and Alakotila has thrived over a remarkable 35 years, long enough to the Finnish pair to develop a stunning intimacy and telepathy. Kalaniemi is a lovingly melodic accordion player, with a sharp ear for a good tune, building each one into a thing of great beauty, while pianist Alakotila not only supports her but adds enough of his own to help transform every piece into a glistening gem.
There�s a sense of calmness to the work here, a long, sweet exhalation between two instrumentalists who are deep enough in sync to allow seamless improvisation beyond any written score and carry the listeners along with them. For much of the album, it�s just the pair of them, including Kalaniemi�s wordless voice, as on the opener, the tradional �Lyck�nskan.� She does charmingly sing lyrics on the title track, written by Lasse M�rtenson, with the sound there neatly and sparingly expanded with the addition of a string quartet.
Morgondimma
There are several original pieces alongside the tradition, with Kalaniemi�s �Hambo Vid F�bodan� a real standout, and it�s perhaps inevitable on any disc featuring accordion that a Piazzolla tune should be included, brings its own shadows to the whole (�Oblivion�). And, this being Finland, a tango is almost obligatory, in this case Alakotila�s �Tango Berlin.�
Tango Berlin
There�s a gentle, dreamlike quality to so much of this, flowing and mellifluous. The pieces aren�t an arena for showy virtuosity. Instead, the two musicians serve the tune, exploring and genuinely enjoying their performances.
It won�t shake the earth, but it makes for some true listening beauty.

items.body:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur.  Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth.
Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I�m guessing here), and musical saw.
Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt)
The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle,  just to get the list started.
Ukulele Lady (excerpt)
The liner notes point out that �Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.� Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous �Ukulele Lady� from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie�s 1971 album
Hobo�s Lullaby
. The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler.
N'oublie pas Gr�co (excerpt)
A more serious item is �N�oublie pas Gr�co� (Don�t Forget Gr�co�)  is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gr�co, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like �Fum�e aux yeux� (�Smoke Gets in Your Eyes�),  �Boude pas� (�Take Five�), and �Prive d�amour� (�As Time Goes By�).
This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, �The young have fire, but we have light.� In its own little corner,
Les Crimes du Musette
shines bright.

items.body:
Live at Rockpalast 1999
documents a command performance at the Loreley open-air amphitheater by Malcolm �Mac� Rebennack Jr., aka Dr. John. Rockpalast is a live-music TV show broadcast since 1974 by Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR), the archival source for this CD-DVD package, and coincidentally a remarkable cultural institution on its own terms.
Taped at the height of Dr. John�s international popularity, backing the singer-pianist-guitarist are New Orleans stalwarts Bobby Broom (guitar), David Barard (bass), and Herman Ernest (drums), a tight quartet that projects authority and engages the crowd from start to close.
A striking UNESCO-designated World Heritage Site set, the Loreley is a slate pinnacle on a mythic horseshoe bend of the Rhine River, memorializing an enduring German literary legend both tragic and romantic. The setting is thus well-suited for Mac�s mystical spirit and lyrical style. By this stage of his career, he characterized his live show as a Mardi Gras revue with a mix of New Orleans standards and some of his most recognizable compositions.
Hence, he opens with the NOLA classic �Iko, Iko,� a half-sung, half-chanted celebration of community participation in the renowned Mardi Gras second-line street procession. Then comes the in-your-face boast �Qualified,� wherein the singer warns, �I got the power to control / I can see clean through you, blind mole / I want to tell you now, I'm qualified / You know that I'm qualified.�
Any Dr. John fan will recognize �I Walk on Guilded Splinters,� a moody, percussively insistent, foreboding expression of the Night Tripper�s immersion in �funknology� (his term), gris-gris herbology, and hoodoo incantation, punctuated with jungle growls and cries, a loopy, spooky slide whistle, and an extended psych-guitar solo: �Walk thru the fire / Fly thru the smoke / See my enemy / At the end of dey rope.�
Every piece in this well- honed set deserves considertion. Although Dr John lived for many years in Los Angeles and New York, his enduring hometown connection shows in the fond inclusion of his own �Sweet Home New Orleans� and �Goin� Back to New Orleans,� and he nods to a key influence with a funky rendering of Duke Ellington�s �I'm Gonna Go Fishin�.� Among other gems are Mac�s Top�10 hit �Right Place, Wrong Time,� and the instantly recognizable closer, Earl King�s �Big Chief,� another Mardi Gras burner.
Regarding his live performance approach, per the notes, �I always play a little bit of everything. I think that�s what music�s about: a little bit of somethin� old, somethin� in the middle, somethin� new, and somethin� as yet uncreated.�
Dr John's�s longtime fans will welcome this archival gem, which also is a solid introduction for any late comers to the party. Surmounting the barriers of language and culture, the power of
At the Rockpalast
is also evident in the enthusiastic audience response. As he declares, �If you�re gonna get off on somethin� you don�t need to know nothin� about it. Music is a universal language.�

items.body: Back after a decade with a new, career-best album, A.C. Williams and Alex Townend open up to Bernie Brooks about their hiatus and subsequent return to Vision Fortune III by VISION FORTUNE "We're both pretty therapy-pilled at this point", says A.C. Williams of Vision Fortune. "But we haven't had group therapy like Metallica or anything", replies his partner-in-crime Alex Townend, dryly. "I do just want to mention that." "That is one of our favourite documentaries!", laughs Williams. At the moment, I'm reasonably certain that Williams and Townend – formerly known to the public as the brothers Peru – aren't lying to me. Once incorrigible obfuscators sowing confusion, treating interviews as "creative writing sessions", the newly resurfaced prodigal sons of the ATP set are back on... items._cn_summary: 本文是英国乐队Vision Fortune的访谈节选，讲述他们在沉寂十年后携新专辑Vision Fortune III回归的经历。两位成员A.C. Williams与Alex Townend以坦诚且带有黑色幽默的方式回顾了乐队的休整期，坦言自己热衷心理治疗但未像Metallica纪录片那样接受团体治疗。文章着重呈现乐队从早年刻意制造混淆、制造距离感的姿态转变为如今坦诚沟通的过程，提到了他们与英国独立音乐厂牌ATP（All Tomorrow's Parties）的渊源。内容为访谈片段而非正式专辑评论，对音乐本身的音色、编曲、制作手法着墨甚少，信息量有限。整体语调轻松，但与实验、前卫、暗潮等核心听音乐向的关联较弱，更偏向独立摇滚范畴。

items.body: Review by Lewian — It is somewhat frustrating about rock from the old communist GDR (East Germany) that the possibilityof censorship didn't only affect the lyrics but apparently also had an impact on the music itself.People were strongly discouraged to think outside the box, and also to sound outside the box. Soproper innovation was very hard to find if at all. Everyone apparently wanted to (or had to) soundnice and civilised. In the 70s it was possible to play harder rock music if it clearly referenced,copied or covered rock'n roll and blues from the west as this was seen as anti western establishmentrebellion and therefore OK (at least at a certain time point), but rebellion against the ownconditions of life in the east wasn't allowed. This also meant that anything more aggressive anddark couldn't be done in innovative ways and couldn't directly relate to the musicians' daily life,seriously affecting creativity. Any opposition had to be subtle, often covered by nice melodicmusic, often enough straight and easy to listen to, and often of little attraction to the proglistener 40 years or so later. Lyrics were often poetic and indirect. Innovation could be brought in best by incorporating classical musicinfluences, as Electra and Stern Meissen did, and Lift to some extent. I believe that the situationfor creativity was really more problematic in the GDR than it was for example in Poland, Hungary andthe Czech Republic, but I can't know for sure (certainly there was a more lively jazz scene in thelatter countries).Lift's Meeresfahrt is one of the best albums to negotiate these conditions. It is in factastonishing that the major theme of longing for travel and far away countries on this album didn'tcreate problems with the censors, as far as I know, given that most people were not allowed totravel outside the eastern communist block of countries. The album is very melodic indeed, the band doesn't rock hard (OK a little bit in very few places),but they are good at what they do. Most arrangements are dominated by the two very good keyboarders.The vocals are also attractive, clean and melodic. The opener "Wir fahrn uebers Meer" is an exampleof copying western blues rock. Maybe the band used this to distract the censors, because in my viewit is by far the weakest track. This is followed by the extremely beautiful "Nach Sueden" ("GoSouth"). Not the proggiest track, but featuring a wonderful melody, a strong keyboard part, andlyrics on migrating birds that probably expressed the longing of many young people in the GDR butwere seemingly (and surprisingly) innocent enough for the censors to let the band get away withthis. A highlight!"Scherbenglas" is an example for the classical influence, using only a string section and voice. Norock at all but interesting and not bad. "Tagesreise" has an epic melody and works well asrecommendation piece for the prog fan with some contrasts and several sections. The second highlightof the album.On the B-side, "Meeresfahrt" (something like "Journey at Sea") is the longest track. It developsslowly from calm keyboards into a mostly instrumental journey featuring the keyboarders andsaxophonist in particular. This is surely enjoyable even though it may be a bit too long for what itis. "Sommernacht" is a calm good night song referencing traditional singing. It works well asending, even though not very interesting from the instrumental point of view. "Tagesreise" and "Meeresfahrt" hold most interest from the prog point of view, but the album hasvery nice elements also elsewhere if you are into melodic rock. It has light influences fromclassical music, jazz and blues. It has good variety but also comes over as consistent featuring acharacteristic style, particularly the melodies and keyboards. The most similar band I can think of is Novalis. Personally I'd rank this as thesecond best GDR prog/art rock album (after Stern Meissen's Reise zum Mittelpunkt des Menschen). 3.7stars.Sadly, few months after the release of this album in 1978, band members Henry Pacholski and GerhardZachar died in a traffic accident and the band would never be the same anymore.
items._genre: crossover prog / GDR rock / keyboard-driven melodic prog
items._cn_summary: 这张1978年东德专辑在审查体制下诞生，乐评用大量篇幅讨论共产主义国家中艺术家如何通过隐晦抒情规避审查，而非深入音乐本身。专辑以两位键盘手为主导，旋律流畅、编曲工整，主要通过古典音乐影响来获得有限创新空间。曲目多为甜美抒情路线，偶有蓝调摇滚借用，整体偏保守。即使身处小众东德场景、带有独特文化历史背景，但音乐本体偏向主流旋律摇滚，实验性与前卫元素极为有限，缺乏创新音色设计与跨界融合。乐评对文化语境的讨论远多于对音乐语言的分析，信息密度偏向历史背景而非音响体验。

items.body: Review by alainPP — Quivira?the legendary name of a city of gold, forever sought but never found!It is also the concept behind an album by Lisa LaRue, who shines on keyboards and piano.1. (Intro) "The Coming Of The Spaniards" offers a symphonic, solemn, and majestic opening?a melody that stops you in your tracks. The choirs, the piano, the very essence of the music?simply perfect.2. "The Benefits Of Breathing Quietly" follows, featuring Vangelis-esque tones?sublime, with a distant, Native American-inspired breeze. Jake's vocals flirt with the style of Big Big Train; in short, top-tier stuff. The synth kicks in, riding over violin-like tones; it's simple yet beautiful, with hints of Alan Parsons?nothing but quality here.3. "The Plains? Truth" features a slow, drifting violin in "space-folk" mode?an airy instrumental interlude?concluding with an Andalusian acoustic touch that remains captivating throughout.4. "Quivira Bound" places the keyboard center stage; Jake casts a spell with his distinctive voice?not the late John, certainly, but his vocals are pure prog. It's an 80s-style ballad with a cheerful air; Lisa brings out a smaller synth before a Southern-rock/Cherokee guitar spirit floods the room with bewitching notes, with John embracing his role as an ex-Korgis member. A stereo finale blends the organ with the crystalline piano.5. "Moving Forward" reminds me of Solstice, featuring a jazzy-folk sound where Joe's violin engages in a musical duel. KANSAS is definitely present here after all, and the keyboards blend perfectly for one of the album's surprising detours.6. "The Turk/Follow The Wind" follows with organ, piano, and violin?sampled or not? That is the question. The drums aren't credited, implying they are programmed, which takes a bit of the shine off the album. Otherwise, it's a fine, energetic track that would have been a hit in the 70s! The cinematic ending puts my mind at ease.7. "Nothing Is Everything" marks the second half of the album?Side B. It has that KANSAS vibe again, with plenty of piano; softer yet dynamic, it feels like an 80s tune?over 40 years old; is it impossible to invent something new these days? Anyway, at times I hear ALAN PARSONS in "Andalusian mode"?it's a strange sensation.8. "Carved From The Sun," with its warm organ, reminds me of SHADOW GALLERY?that's just how it is. The velvety keyboard work lets the track drift along a smooth, seamless melodic path?paradoxically so.9. "Kicking Rocks" arrives, driven by a catchy guitar and a heavy riff; then it settles back down for a repeat performance.10. "Prelude To Anywhere/Weekend Conquistadors"... is it the spellbinding piano, the violin, or the synth? A beautiful ballad assaulted by John's hard-rocking riff, with the piano returning to sweep away any lingering heaviness. A masterful battle between the two instruments?top-tier stuff?with Jake setting things on fire, as does the PROTO-KAW-style vocal.11. "Still Breathing," with notes that recall TEARS FOR FEARS?that's just how it is. The final track; instead of leaving me breathless, it fills me up. A ballad?a lament balancing tenderness and emotion?featuring a violin? a keyboard? building to a dreamlike crescendo that drifts away on the musical breeze. A touch of Alan Parsons once again highlights the profound musicality of this final, spellbinding track. Off you go, steed?scram!QUIVIRA: symphonic progressive rock; a modern myth and vision of our troubled society set to music; melodic instrumental prog with occasional vocals?very good, yet it also tends to go in circles. Mr. Cadbury really shouldn't have wandered in.(3.75)
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以西班牙征服者寻找黄金之城Quivira的神话为概念框架，由键盘手Lisa LaRue主导编曲，融合了交响前卫摇滚的庄严开篇与80年代抒情谣曲的怀旧气息。乐评提及大量对Vangelis、Kansas、Alan Parsons、Big Big Train等前辈乐队的风格参照，器乐编制以键盘、小提琴、合成器为核心，辅以纳瓦霍原住民与安达卢西亚音乐元素作为色彩点缀。编曲在段落铺陈上较工整，偶有爵士民谣与南方摇滚的即兴对话，但整体仍属模式化的复古再现，鼓机替代真人鼓手的处理被乐评视为减分项。对偏好实验前卫、学术爵士、电子与世界融合的听众而言，此作缺乏声学边界拓展与结构创新，呈现出典型的怀旧向新古典交响前卫框架。

items.body: Harry Birch wrote “Don’t Give Up” while he was drinking himself under and his mother was dying of bone cancer. “This song saved me,” he says. He wrote it for her. The music pulls against all that: warm bass, guitar ringing bright over it, the tempo unhurried. Only the first line gives it away, Birch calling himself “a whiskey walking junkie”. Halfway through the song, he hands a verse to Lunda, a French-Congolese singer working in soul and indie rock. The chorus asks for time to put a broken life back together: “Please don’t give up on me / ‘Cause oh on our love we can revive / the pieces of our life…” Birch is Kaya Street, the Bristol project he writes, sings and produces. He formed it in 2014 as a ten-piece soul band, broke it up in early 2024 to get into the studio properly, then rebuilt it at the end of that year around live horns, drums and electronics. Juno-winning Toronto producer Dubmatix is producing the next Kaya Street album. “Don’t Give Up” stands apart from the afrobeat he usually works in, and from the political songs that come with it. items._cn_summary: Harry Birch（艺名Kaya Street）来自布里斯托尔，在母亲因骨癌离世、自己沉溺酒精的低谷中写下这首《Don't Give Up》，歌曲以温暖贝斯线与明亮的吉他音色为基底，节奏舒缓，歌词袒露脆弱。副歌部分交给法国-刚果裔歌手Lunda献声，两人合唱中呈现请求与回应式的情感对话。Kaya Street最初是十人灵魂乐队，2024年重组后聚焦现场铜管、鼓机与电子元素，制作风格偏向灵魂乐与非洲节拍的跨界。此前作品以非洲节奏与政治议题著称，这首单曲则向更私人的灵魂抒情靠拢。即将由多伦多制作人Dubmatix操刀新专辑。此文偏向新闻稿性质，缺乏深度音乐分析。

items.body: Disorder Festival, a new two-day event dedicated to the international goth, coldwave, darkwave, post-punk and EBM scenes, takes place in Montreuil, just outside Paris, on 6 and 7 February 2027. The festival spreads across four venues in the same neighbourhood instead of a single site: La Marbrerie, Le Chinois, Le Bal Chavaux and La Bicyclette. The first fifteen acts have already been announced, among them Martin Dupont, Frustration and David Shaw & The Beat, with more names still to come. A further wave of artists is due to be revealed on 30 October. Some artists will be available for interviews, and press and photo accreditation can be arranged through the festival’s local PR, Take Me Out. About Disorder Festival Disorder is a new festival built around the international goth, coldwave, darkwave, post-punk and EBM scenes, set to debut in Montreuil on 6 and 7 February 2027. The organisers are spreading the event across four venues in the same part of Montreuil instead of concentrating it in one site: La Marbrerie, Le Chinois, Le Bal Chavaux and La Bicyclette. The first confirmed names include Martin Dupont, Frustration and David Shaw & The Beat, with the remainder of the fifteen-act first wave and a further round of bookings still to be made public.

items.body: Novena Senda releases the single and music video “A la deriva”, the first preview of the Barcelona band’s second album. The song moves between darkwave and the Spanish-language rock of Héroes del Silencio, wrapped in an atmosphere the band ties to the 1980s and 1990s. “A la deriva” deals with exhaustion and the feeling of being lost. It follows Novena Senda’s 2022 debut album “Laberinto de Voces”, the record that established the band’s sound between darkwave and Spanish-language rock, with echoes of Depeche Mode and Héroes del Silencio. About Novena Senda The band formed in Barcelona in 2017, with Lorenzo Ferrer, Edu Migueles and David Arroyo making up the band. Their 2022 debut album “Laberinto de Voces” set out the sound they have built on since: darkwave merged with Spanish-language rock, carrying an atmosphere that nods to Depeche Mode and Héroes del Silencio. “A la deriva”, released in 2026, is the first single from the follow-up to that debut, with the rest of the album still to come.
items._cn_summary: 西班牙巴塞罗那乐队Novena Senda发行单曲《A la deriva》，作为其第二张专辑的首支预热作品。这首歌在暗潮与西班牙语摇滚之间游走，乐队声称其氛围可追溯至1980至1990年代，并提及Depeche Mode与Héroes del Silencio的影响。歌曲主题围绕疲惫与迷失感展开。乐队成立于2017年，2022年首张专辑《Laberinto de Voces》奠定了这一混合风格的基础。本文为标准新闻稿格式，发布平台Side-Line属于独立/地下音乐媒体，但内容缺乏对音乐本身的详细乐评，更像是单曲发行的宣传通稿。整体音乐定位偏向传统暗潮与主流摇滚的结合，创新性较为有限。

items.body: Corlyx released “The Holy Vampire” on 1 October 2026, the fourth single from “The Crimson Tapes,” the darkwave trio’s next album due in early 2027 on Out Of Line Music. Guitarist and producer Brandon Ashley made the track with singer Caitlin Stokes, who also directed and edited its companion video alongside Sereina Winters. Ashley called the track’s tone deliberate: “It’s also quite camp, which Corlyx is a huge fan of.” He placed it close to 2025’s “Purple Pain,” pairing dancefloor elements with a harder deathrock edge than that album. Corlyx’s ‘The Holy Vampire’ leads to ‘The Crimson Tapes’ “The Holy Vampire” is streaming now and available on Bandcamp. About Corlyx Corlyx call their sound “Death Pop,” a label singer Caitlin Stokes coined for a mix of 1980s post-punk and goth rock. The band started in Los Angeles, releasing its first single, “Starlet,” in February 2016, and now splits its time between the UK and Italy, where Stokes works with guitarist and producer Brandon Ashley and bassist Davide Rocco. Corlyx’s video for “Twist Like An Animal” arrived in 2019. The band announced the album “Blood In The Disco” in 2021 behind the single “Take Off Everything,” then returned in 2024 with “Zombie Kid” ahead of the double album “Purple Pain” the following year. Corlyx has toured Europe, the UK and the US with Lord Of The Lost, Massive Ego, Ashbury Heights, Blutengel and Twin Tribes. “Sweeter Than Blood,” “More Anarchy” and “Your Heart In The Serpent’s Mouth” preceded “The Holy Vampire” as the first three singles from “The Crimson Tapes.”

items.body: Danish/UK electronic duo Oui Plastique release the single “For The Cry Of Anguish” on October 16, 2026 through Town and Towers Records. It is the fourth and final single from the project’s second album, “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It”, due November 27, 2026 on the same Danish label. A Bandcamp page for the single had not gone live at the time of writing. Oui Plastique close the singles campaign for ‘Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It’ “For The Cry Of Anguish” follows three earlier singles from the same album: “Revival” in April 2026, “Linger” on June 12, 2026, and “Spirit” on September 4, 2026. “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It” is Oui Plastique’s second album, following the 2022 debut “Fraternity of Strangers”. It runs 14 tracks and releases digitally, on CD and on vinyl through Town and Towers Records on November 27, 2026. Oui Plastique set up the song’s premise directly: “For The Cry Of Anguish is a song about seeing something you were never meant to see – and discovering that some things, once witnessed, can never be unseen.“ Oui Plastique previously posted a teaser video for “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It” to the duo’s YouTube channel, titled “Oui Plastique – ‘Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It’ – Album Teaser”. About Oui Plastique Oui Plastique is the duo of Martin Nyrup (Denmark) and James Thomas (UK). The project grew out of a 2017 collaboration between Nyrup, also one half of the dark wave duo Perpacity, and Thomas, of the band DVL, who together recorded the album “Convergence” that year. In 2018 the pair recorded a three-track covers EP for the UnMute project, a tribute to Mute Records, released on Bandcamp as “UM EP 04” on February 1, 2019. Before the debut album, four of its eventual tracks appeared as standalone digital singles: “Failure” on March 8, 2021, “The Fear” on May 28, 2021, “Crossing Over” on September 24, 2021, and “Wish Yourself Away” on November 26, 2021. The 11-track debut album “Fraternity of Strangers” followed on January 28, 2022, on CD through ScentAir Records. A remastered edition of “Convergence” followed in 2022. In August 2025, the UnMute covers were remastered and reissued across platforms as the EP “UnMute”, featuring the Martin Gore-associated tracks “Compulsion”, “The Bottom Line” and “It Doesn’t Matter Two”, through Town and Towers Records. Nyrup’s other project, Perpacity, released the album “Discordia” in 2023 and the Danish-language single “Lille Flamme” in May 2025. “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It” arrives on November 27, 2026. It is Oui Plastique’s first full-length through Town and Towers Records, following the 2022 debut on ScentAir Records.

items.body: Death Strip release their fourth single, “Flash Back,” on October 8, 2026. The duo mixes darkwave and EBM with an electro-punk edge. “Flash Back” runs at 136 BPM, built on distorted saw bass, strobing arpeggios and deadpan spoken word. Recommend to fans of Boy Harsher, Gesaffelstein and The Prodigy. The single is scheduled to land on Death Strip’s Bandcamp and Spotify pages on release day. About Death Strip Death Strip pairs Jonas Moberg, a Swedish producer and drummer based on Gotland, with vocalist Culture Yob, also known as Son of Daughter, based in Hastings, England. Moberg played drums in the Swedish rock band Jumper, which released three albums and eleven singles between 1996 and 2000, and later played live drums for Paloma Faith early in her career. Culture Yob co-founded the band Gobsausage with Takalina and Miss Halski in the early 2000s, and also co-founded Charles of London, according to the band. The two met in the 2000s and lived in neighboring warehouse flats in Shoreditch, London, where they shared a goods lift. They now live apart, Moberg on Gotland and Culture Yob in Hastings, and write and record Death Strip’s music remotely. The two have never been in the same room for a Death Strip session. “Flash Back,” released October 8, 2026, is the fourth single Death Strip has made this way.

items.body:
The 17th Golden Indie Music Awards (GIMA) has unveiled its nominees, with Sunset Rollercoaster, ena mori, KIKI, and N.Y.P.D. 南洋派對 among the acts in the running.

The Taiwanese awards, which celebrate original music, received a record 4,242 submissions this year. Its Best Asian Creative Artist category, dedicated to artists from across Asia outside Taiwan, also reached a new high with 105 entries.

Sunset Rollercoaster’s QUIT QUIETLY is nominated for Best Album, Best Band, and Best Alternative Pop Album, while 'Bluebird' is up for Best Alternative Pop Song. The band’s Tseng Kuo Hung also earned a Best Singer-songwriter nomination for QUIT QUIETLY.

Across the categories, the nominees span jazz, electronic music, hip-hop, and works rooted in different languages and local cultural traditions.

Five works are nominated for Best Asian Creative Artist:

ena mori’s Ore

KIKI’s Death of a Daisy & Birth of an Oyster

SHNTI’s Melting PT.

N.Y.P.D. 南洋派對’s DON’T LIKE 我鍾意

NAMDO CALLING (Jung Eunhye, CADEJO, and Yechan Kim)’s NAMDO CALLING

This year’s theme, "觸 TRUE", pairs the Taiwanese expression “觸” (chù), which describes the feeling of being emotionally struck by something or finding that it deeply resonates, with the English word “TRUE”. It centres on authentic creative expression and its ability to connect across cultures.

The jury is chaired by Fang Q, bassist of Taiwanese band Cosmos People, who said the record number of submissions reflects the vitality and creative diversity of Taiwan’s music scene.

Beyond the competitive categories, Yuhan Su receives the Jury Award for Over The Moons. The GIMA Impact Award honours Blue Note Taipei and its founder Tsai Bop for their longstanding contributions to Taiwan’s jazz culture and live music scene.

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by 金音GIMA (@gima_arf)

Ahead of the ceremony, GIMA LIVE will take place on 21 and 22 October at CORNER MAX in Taipei. The showcase will feature final performances by the Best Live Performance nominees to determine and reveal the winner.

The awards ceremony will be held on 31 October, at 7 PM, at Taipei Music Center, with a livestream available to international audiences.

The full nominees list, GIMA LIVE lineup, and further ceremony details will be available through GIMA’s official Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube channels.

items.body: Review by DimitrisTheHead — Another really strong Procol Harum album, after their debut. Procol Harum is a great example of a less-is-more band, delivering strong music without being to complex or trying to be sophisticated. The music is piano/organ/vocal driven, the trademark Procol Harum sound, led by Gary Brooker and his warm, emotional voice. Matthew Fisher on the organ is again fantastic. The album is not loaded with guitar, but when Robin Trower comes in, he delivers some really tasty and artful sounds.I like all the songs here, and the highlight is the heavy psychedelic/progressive suite "In Held 'Twas In I" with classical and Eastern music influences.

items._cn_summary: 这是Procol Harum的第二张录音室专辑，延续了其首张专辑的风格路线，以钢琴、风琴与人声为核心驱动力，构成了该乐队标志性的温暖而情绪化的声音。Gary Brooker的嗓音富有情感张力，Matthew Fisher的风琴演奏同样出色，Robin Trower的吉他虽不占据主导，但每次出现都带来富有艺术性的音色。整张专辑以长篇套曲"In Held 'Twas In I"最为突出，这首作品将迷幻与前卫元素结合，并融入古典音乐和东方音乐的色彩，构成了专辑的重心所在。乐评认为这是一支懂得以简洁方式呈现强烈音乐的乐队，不以复杂或刻意精致取胜，而是通过克制的编排传达力量。整体而言，专辑在迷幻摇滚与早期前卫摇滚之间找到了平衡点，长篇作品为专辑提供了深度。

items.body: Lacrimosa released their seventh studio album, “Fassade,” through Hall of Sermon and Nuclear Blast on 1 October 2001. The gothic metal record turns 25 this year. The Swiss duo, Tilo Wolff and Anne Nurmi, recorded and mixed “Fassade” between January and June 2001 at Impuls Musicproductions in Hamburg, with orchestral parts performed by the Deutsches Filmorchester Babelsberg recorded in March 2001 at the Scoring Stage in Berlin. JP Genkel recorded and mixed the album, and Helge Halvé handled mastering in July 2001. Wolff arranged, produced and sang on the record; Nurmi wrote and sang the album’s English-language track, “Senses,” while Wolff wrote the remaining seven songs. The eight-track album is built around the title piece “Fassade,” a three-part composition split across tracks one, five and eight, with the remaining songs, “Der Morgen danach,” “Senses,” “Warum so tief?,” “Liebesspiel” and “Stumme Worte,” filling out a 52-minute run time. “Fassade” reached number 20 on the German Albums Chart and number 31 in Switzerland, following 1999’s “Elodia,” which had marked the band’s commercial breakthrough with the London Symphony Orchestra. “Fassade” streams on Spotify. About Lacrimosa Tilo Wolff founded Lacrimosa in Frankfurt, Germany, in 1990, recording a demo tape titled “Clamor” before launching his own label, Hall of Sermon, in 1991 to release the debut album “Angst.” A harlequin has appeared on every Lacrimosa album cover since, becoming the band’s logo. Wolff released “Einsamkeit” (1992) and “Satura” (1993) as the project’s sole member before Finnish musician Anne Nurmi, formerly of the gothic rock band Two Witches, joined as a permanent second member in 1994. Nurmi has contributed her own compositions in Finnish and English on every album since “Inferno” (1995), which became the band’s first charting release in Germany. “Stille” (1997) introduced the heavier, symphonic metal direction that defined the band’s sound going forward. “Elodia” (1999) became Lacrimosa’s commercial breakthrough, reaching number 12 in Germany with orchestral parts recorded by the London Symphony Orchestra at Abbey Road Studios. “Fassade” followed on 1 October 2001, continuing the orchestral approach with the Deutsches Filmorchester Babelsberg, an arrangement repeated on “Echos” (2003). In 2008, Hall of Sermon reclaimed the rights to the band’s back catalogue from Nuclear Blast, restoring full independence over the discography. Lacrimosa continued to release albums through the 2000s and 2010s, including “Lichtgestalt” (2005), “Sehnsucht” (2009), “Revolution” (2012), “Hoffnung” (2015) and “Testimonium” (2017), the latter a requiem in four acts dedicated to musicians who died in 2016. Side-Line marked the band’s 25th anniversary in 2015 with the announcement of a new studio album, and reported on the band’s 2021 return with “Leidenschaft,” delayed at the time by a worldwide paper shortage. Side-Line also covered the 2023 release of the double live CD “Nachts” on Hall of Sermon. “Lament,” released in 2025, completed a stylistic trilogy begun with “Testimonium” and debuted at number 7 in Germany, the band’s highest chart position since “Elodia.” Lacrimosa remains one of the longest-running self-released acts in the gothic metal scene, operating continuously through Wolff’s own label since 1991. “Fassade” turns 25 this year, marking a quarter century since the band’s most explicit engagement with themes of individuality and societal conformity.
items._cn_summary: 本文为Side-Line刊载的纪念性新闻稿，纪念Lacrimosa第七张录音室专辑《Fassade》发行25周年。文章以编年史方式回顾了专辑的录制信息：由Tilo Wolff与Anne Nurmi组成的瑞士二人组于2001年1月至6月在汉堡Impuls Musicproductions录音，3月在柏林由德国电影乐团（Babelsberg）演奏管弦乐部分，8月由Helge Halvé完成母带处理。专辑包含8首曲目，总时长约52分钟，以三段式标题曲《Fassade》为核心架构。发行后曾在德国专辑榜排名第20、瑞士第31。文章同时梳理了乐队从1990年Tilo Wolff在法兰克福创立至Anne Nurmi1994年加入的发展脉络，提及标志性的小丑封面形象、Hall of Sermon自有厂牌的运营，以及与Nuclear Blast的合作与回归独立的过程。作为一篇信息性纪念文章，内容详实但缺乏对音乐本身的深度分析与美学评价。

items.body: Wumpscut’s eighth studio album, “Wreath of Barbs,” turns 25 this year. The German electro-industrial project released the record on 1 October 2001 through Beton Kopf Media in Germany, with Metropolis Records issuing the US edition on 9 October 2001. Wumpscut is the recording name of Bavarian musician Rudy Ratzinger, who wrote, arranged, performed, mixed and mastered the album himself. “Wreath of Barbs” runs eleven tracks: “Opening the Gates of Hell,” “Deliverance (Album Mix),” “Wreath of Barbs (Album Mix),” “Dr. Thodt,” “Mankind’s Disease,” “Christfuck,” “Troops Under Fire,” “Line of Corpses,” “Hate Is Mine,” “Bleed in Silence” and a remix of Kirlian Camera’s “Eclipse,” titled “Eclipse (Kaelte Container Remix).” Aleta Welling contributes female vocals and wrote the lyrics for “Wreath of Barbs” and “Dr. Thodt.” The album peaked at #13 on the CMJ RPM Chart in the US. Exclaim! described it as “a celebration of darkness and foreboding” and praised “Ratzinger’s talent for writing a catchy song.” Concurrent with the release, Ratzinger ran a remix contest for the title track, providing samples through his website and inviting any musician to submit a version for a chance at inclusion on the subsequent “Wreath of Barbs” MCD. The album has since seen multiple reissues, including a 2017 “Concentrated Camp Edition” and a DAT edition, and Wumpscut announced vinyl reissues of “Wreath of Barbs” and “Body Census” in December 2021. About Wumpscut Wumpscut, stylised as :wumpscut:, is a gothic-influenced electro-industrial project founded in Munich, Bavaria, in May 1991 by DJ Rudy Ratzinger, born Rudolf Ratzinger in 1966 in Gangkofen, West Germany. Ratzinger has remained the project’s sole member throughout its history, occasionally bringing in guest contributors such as vocalist Aleta Welling. He has cited the early work of Leæther Strip as his reason for moving from DJing to recording, saying in a 1997 interview that he “was a DJ for several years and was tired of offering the audience only alien stuff.” Wumpscut’s first release was the demo cassette “Defcon” in late 1991, followed by the project’s first full-length album, “Music for a Slaughtering Tribe,” in 1993. That album’s track “Soylent Green” drew early attention in goth and industrial club circuits in Germany, the UK and the US. Wumpscut released “Bunkertor 7” in 1995 and “Embryodead” in 1997, the latter reaching #20 on the CMJ RPM chart. The 1999 album “Boeses Junges Fleisch,” built around the life of German serial killer Fritz Haarmann, reached #25 on the CMJ RPM chart and #17 on the German Alternative Charts. The 2000 EP “Blutkind” followed, reaching #5 on the DAC Top 50 Albums of 2000 in Germany and #17 on the CMJ RPM chart in the US. Ratzinger started his own label, Beton Kopf Media, in 1995 to release Wumpscut material to the European market, and later ran the label Mental Ulcer Forges. “Wreath of Barbs,” released in 2001 through Beton Kopf Media in Germany and Metropolis Records in the US, reached #13 on the CMJ RPM Chart, the project’s highest US chart placement to date. Wumpscut has continued releasing albums since, including “Wüterich” (2016), “Fledermavs 303” (2021), “Schlossgheist” (2024) and “Chew Chew Chew” (2025), while remaining a studio-only project that has never toured. Twenty-five years on, “Wreath of Barbs” remains one of the project’s most commercially successful releases.
items._cn_summary: 本文为Wumpscut第八张录音室专辑《Wreath of Barbs》发行25周年的纪念性介绍，属于信息性新闻稿而非深度乐评。文章梳理了专辑的发行信息、曲目列表、合作者及商业成绩，并简要回顾了Wumpscut作为德国巴伐利亚电子工业项目的历史沿革。专辑融合电子工业与哥特暗潮风格，Ratzinger独自完成词曲、编曲、演奏及混音制作，Aleta Welling为部分曲目贡献女声与歌词。文章提及该作品曾在美国CMJ RPM榜单取得第13名，并被媒体评价为黑暗与不祥氛围的庆典，Ratzinger在创作中展现出对旋律感的把控。整体而言，这篇文本侧重于事实陈述与背景介绍，缺乏对音乐本身的声音设计、创作手法或艺术价值的深入分析。

items.body:
Tiny Sun creates tiny songs that give off light and heat well out of proportion to their size. Composed, performed, and produced by Martina Sorbara, Jonathan Goldsmith, and Don Rooke, the record is vaguely Americana, with plucked guitars and ukuleles, chiming keyboards, and the lonesome slide of the guitar.
Vanishment
contains eighteen sparkling miniatures - that take a scant 34 minutes to negotiate - notable for their economy of arrangement and the subtle directness of the lyrics. The tracks glow with Martina�s clear, high, and sometimes fragile voice.
The songs are about loss: lost love, lost confidence, but sometimes about resignation to the enigmatic quirks of the world. The tone of wry fatalism mirrors the fact that this project is the work of many years of collaboration and email exchanges while the trio pursued their musical day jobs. Jonathan Goldsmith is an award-winning composer for television and film, Don Rooke fronts the Toronto roots band The Henrys, and Martina Sorbara is known for folk, electropop, and her band Dragonette.
Kerosene Madrigal
The range of backgrounds leads to many styles, and the record betrays interesting influences. The opening track, �Kerosene Madrigal,� is a sort of miner�s blues reminiscent of Michelle Shocked. The soul-country of �Imagined Love� reminded me of fellow Torontonians Cowboy Junkies, especially the sweet organ. The stoic and twangy �Don�t Fault the Stars for Falling� could have been a Dolly Parton tune.
A Grand Expanse
�A Grand Expanse� has a more ambitious arrangement.  It sounds like the end-credits song from a long-ago film we only vaguely remember. It says everything it needs to in one minute and twenty seconds and exactly 38 words. It is quintessential Tiny Sun.
The entire recording feels like music from a dream, and since no one knows exactly what dream music sounds like, this could be it.
Berceuse
Tiny Sun will perform the entire album at Toronto�s Koerner Hall on May 14, 2026.

items.body: In August 1819, tens of thousands of working men and women gathered in St. Peter�s Field in Manchester to hear the politician Henry Hunt speak. They were difficult times, many still out of work after the Napoleonic wars, rising prices and low wages � and always those at the bottom of the heap suffering. Hunt was a famed orator, a man on the side of the people, able to stir and inspire with his voice. Although the gathering was peaceful, the size of the crowd terrified the magistrates, who panicked and imagined an uprising. They sent in half-trained dragoons and the cavalry, who rode down, slashed and killed without compunction or compassion. In the end, 18 died and up to 700 were wounded. It was a stain on the nation, an outrage; prompting Percy Shelley, one of the poetic giants of the age, to write The Masque of Anarchy , with its famous lines: �Rise like Lions after slumber / in unvanquishable number / She your chains to earth like dew / Which in sleep had fallen on you / Ye are many - they are few.� Peterloo, as people called it, remains one of the seminal events in English working-class history, one that Sean Cooney of the Young 'Uns has revisited for this album of original songs, which is lavishly presented in a book with contemporary letters, political cartoons and illustrations to create a multimedia event. It�s ambitious, no doubt about that, and he�s selected some great talent to help � guitarist Sam Carter, the almost ubiquitous fiddler/singer Eliza Carthy, Ben Nicholls supplying background and texture on various instruments, and the Lancashire industrial ballad singer Jennifer Reid, who doubles as narrator. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid For a small ensemble, they make a powerful noise. The songs capture the feel of the day; the anticipation and excitement at the summer gathering, the joy that turns to terror and flight as the troops charge, then the bitter, mournful aftermath, voiced some powerful melodies and very well-chosen images. As a writer, Cooney often focuses on the personal in the small tales of people like �Sam Bamford� and �Mary Fildes,� while the three short pieces that comprise �The Monkey Rides The Mare� capture the bluster and arrogance of the soldiers. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid Cooney is a persuasive singer, and on this heartfelt project, he puts plenty of emotion into his voice. Having two other outstanding vocalists alongside him makes for a wonderful triple threat. In these days when governments across the world are cracking down on protest, this stands as a sobering and very timely reminder. It�s a history lesson, yes, but the detail of the history stays in the book, while the music creates a set of songs that will resonate and remain for a long time. Find the artist online. items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以1819年曼彻斯特圣彼得广场大屠杀（Peterloo Massacre）为题材，由Young 'Uns成员Sean Cooney创作的一组原创歌曲组成，搭配当代书信、政治漫画与插图，以多媒体形式呈现历史事件。制作邀请了Sam Carter、Eliza Carthy、Ben Nicholls及兰开夏工业民谣歌手Jennifer Reid等音乐人参与，乐评提及音乐虽来自小编制却能产生强大声响，歌曲捕捉了集会当日的期待、骑兵冲击的恐怖与悲痛的余波，并穿插对历史人物的个人叙事。乐评肯定了三位歌手的人声表现以及旋律与意象的选择，认为在当下全球政府压制抗议的背景下具有现实意义。从风格来看，这是一张以英格兰历史叙事为核心的传统民谣作品，属于纯民谣范畴，与用户偏好的实验、前卫、爵士、电子等方向距离较远。

items.body: Miss Construction returns with “This Is Crap”, a new EBM and industrial-electro album that pairs eleven new tracks with a reissue of the project’s 2008 debut. Out 27 November 2026 on Out Of Line as a 2CD digipak, it follows “Boys & Ladies”, the sixth single, released 30 September. Disc one holds the eleven new tracks: This Is Crap (Intro) 6666 Heiß Hate Spiel Mit Mir Back Again F.M.P. Boys & Ladies This Is War Bully Du This Is Crap by Miss Construction Disc two reissues “Kunstprodukt,” Miss Construction’s debut album, originally released 28 April 2008 on Fear Section. It adds two archival remixes to the original sixteen tracks: the title track remixed by Gintronic, and “Electro Beast” remixed by Dolls Of Pain. “Boys & Ladies” arrived as an official video through Out Of Line Music’s YouTube channel on 30 September, embedded below. Miss Construction’s road back to ‘This Is Crap’ “Boys & Ladies” caps a run of five singles that marked Miss Construction’s return: “Spiel Mit Mir” in October 2025, “Back Again” in December 2025, then “Heiß,” “Hate” and “F.M.P.” through 2026. “This Is Crap” is available to pre-order now through the Out Of Line shop and on Bandcamp. About Miss Construction Miss Construction began in 2008 as a side project of Chris Pohl, who had fronted Blutengel since 1996. Pohl brought in Gordon Mocznay as co-vocalist, and the pair debuted the project at Wave-Gotik-Treffen in Leipzig that year. Its opening statement was a cover of Terminal Choice’s “Totes Fleisch,” placed on the debut album “Kunstprodukt,” released 28 April 2008 on Fear Section, an Out Of Line sublabel. Pohl and Mocznay followed it with “United Trash – The Z Files” in November 2013. Between full-lengths, Miss Construction contributed remixes to Blutengel and Dance Or Die compilations between 2009 and 2011, including the “Awake The Machines” and “Industrial For The Masses” series, before the project went quiet for twelve years. Pohl revived Miss Construction in 2025. “Spiel Mit Mir” opened the comeback that October, “Back Again” followed in December, and “Heiß,” “Hate,” “F.M.P.” and “Boys & Ladies” continued it through 2026. “This Is Crap” closes that run of singles and gives “Kunstprodukt” its first reissue.

items.body: Swedish synthpop act Split Vision release the single “Cold War” on 2 October 2026 through the Danish label Town And Towers Records. The track is the second single from the band’s upcoming album “BetaCity”, due on 6 November 2026 on streaming, CD and vinyl. “Cold War” follows “Out of Nowhere”, released on 10 September 2026 as the first single from “BetaCity.” The new track moves into darker territory than its predecessor. Sequenced synthesizers underpin lyrics that revisit Cold War-era paranoia, isolation and secrecy as a metaphor for conflict and uncertainty. The lyrics were written by the band’s label manager, Stig Wintendorff, in the 1980s. The chorus repeats the song’s central image: “Dancing in the shadows of the Cold War night.” The single’s cover artwork draws on Cold War-era imagery: masks, military hardware and Soviet-style visual motifs. Split Vision’s ‘BetaCity’ album Split Vision’s previous album, “Echoes of a New Spell” (2025, Town And Towers Records), drew on the synthesizers and recording approach associated with early Depeche Mode. “BetaCity” turns instead toward the early sound of Alphaville. Town And Towers Records describes the album’s sound as combining “warm analogue synthesizers with colder digital textures, wavetable sounds, sequenced bass lines and atmospheric pads.” Recommended for fans of Alphaville, Depeche Mode and Erasure. About Split Vision Split Vision formed in Sweden in 1985, when two teenage friends started writing synthpop with influences from Depeche Mode, Yazoo, Erasure and Pet Shop Boys. Two more members joined, and the four-piece played discotheques in North Eastern Skåne and appeared on regional radio and talent shows through the late 1980s. Platinum Records released the single “How Will I Ever” in 1988, and “So Many Times” became a minor hit in Sweden before the group disbanded. Dan Hansson and Henric Palmqvist, two of the original members, restarted Split Vision in the spring of 2019 to write new material rooted in the band’s 1980s sound. “We wanted to take the audience on a journey back to carefully carved arpeggios, that smell of Moog and Yamaha DX-7,” the band said of that return, describing music with “strong melodies performed by a distinct lead and backed by a contemporary vocoder.” The result, “Among the Stars,” arrived on 1 October 2020, with lyrics and soundscapes that reference the cosmos. Split Vision signed to the Scandinavian label Town And Towers Records in 2022 and has released several singles and EPs since. A music video for “Lust,” directed by Norwegian filmmaker Öystein Thorsen, followed in August 2024 and won awards at the New York Tri-State International Film Festival and the KHIFF Krimson Horyzon International Film Festival in India. The band has also toured as a support act for the British group China Crisis. “Echoes of a New Spell” followed in 2025, and “Out of Nowhere” opened the “BetaCity” campaign on 10 September 2026. “Cold War,” released 2 October 2026, is the second single from that album, due on 6 November 2026 through Town And Towers Records.
items._cn_summary: 瑞典合成器流行团体 Split Vision 发布新单曲《Cold War》，为其专辑《BetaCity》的第二支先行曲。歌曲以序列化的合成器为基础，歌词借冷战时期的偏执、孤立与秘密意象隐喻当代冲突与不确定性，封面采用面具、军用装备及苏联视觉元素。新专辑在声音取向上从前作的早期 Depeche Mode 风格转向 Alphaville 式质感，结合温暖模拟合成器与冷峻数字音色、波形表声音、序列低音线条与氛围铺底。乐队重组后延续八〇年代合成器流行血脉，歌词与声景均保持复古基调，制作工整但缺乏突出的实验性或跨界探索，整体偏向怀旧主流合成器流行路线。

items.body: 2026.10.02 10月28日（水）・30日（金）に大阪・京都へ 平岡拓也 音楽ジャーナリスト 1996年生まれ。慶應義塾大学文学部でドイツ語圏の文学・音楽を学ぶ。『音楽の友』『MOSTLY CLASSIC』などの音楽誌、複数のWEBメディア、在京オーケストラの... 詳しく見る エリック・ルー。彼がワルシャワで開かれた第19回ショパン国際ピアノ・コンクールで第1位を獲得してから、1年が過ぎようとしている。 そのルーが10月28日・30日に、ヤープ・ヴァン・ズヴェーデン率いる台湾のエバーグリーン交響楽団（ESO）と共演し、大阪・京都でチャイコフスキーの「ピアノ協奏曲 第1番」を弾く。 華やかな身振りで圧倒するのではなく、一音一音の行方を見つめ、沈黙まで音楽に変えてゆくピアニスト。17歳で第4位となった2015年大会から10年を経て、リーズ国際ピアノ・コンクール優勝などの実績を重ね、すでに国際的なキャリアを築いていた彼は、ワルシャワへ戻って、ついに頂点へ立った。 エリック・ルー（ピアノ） 1997年アメリカのマサチューセッツ州生まれ。ダン・タイ・ソンらに師事し、第19回ショパン国際ピアノ・コンクール（2025）で優勝。 2018年にはリーズ国際ピアノコンクールでも優勝した。思慮に富んだ、詩情あふれる力強い演奏により、すでに世界の音楽シーンでも際立ったアーティストの一人として定評を得ている。シカゴ響、ボストン響、ロンドン響、フィンランド放送響などのオーケストラや、ムーティ、ルイージ、ガードナー、ダウスゴーらの指揮者と共演し、アムステルダムのコンセルトヘボウ、ライプツィヒ・ゲヴァントハウス、シャンゼリゼ劇場などでリサイタルを行っている。ロンドンのウィグモアホールでは7年連続でリサイタルを開き、BBCプロムスやラ・ロック・ダンテロン音楽祭などにも出演。ワーナー・クラシックスと専属契約を結び、シューベルトのソナタ集や最新盤の即興曲集はBBCミュージック・マガジンの器楽部門推薦盤に選ばれるなど高い評価を得ており、国際的な賞も多数受賞している。 内省と熱狂をどう描くのか ～エリック・ルー ルーの美質は、繊細な音色と力強い高揚を矛盾なく両立させるところにある。 2025年のワルシャワの舞台でも、細やかな音色の陰影と、持続する緊張のなかに抑制された美を響かせる演奏が際立った。優勝後、ファビオ・ルイージ指揮・NHK交響楽団と共演したショパンの「ピアノ協奏曲 第2番」も、芯の通った美音と端正な構築を示す、いわば「渋い」秀演だった。 そうした内省的な表現が、ロシア・ロマン派を代表するチャイコフスキーの大協奏曲で、どこまで外へ開かれるのか。 耳なじみのある壮麗な和音で幕を開けるこの協奏曲だが、真価は豪快さだけにとどまらない。 有名な序奏の主題は二度と戻らず、音楽はウクライナ民謡に由来する主題へと進む。ピアノも常に主役でいるのではなく、ときに伴奏へ回り、木管と親密な言葉を交わし、やがて大管弦楽とともに巨大な頂点を築く。 ルーが内省と熱狂の振幅をどう描き、指揮者とオーケストラがその呼吸にどう応えるか。ここに今回の大きな聴きどころがある。コンクールで彼を知った人にとっても、新たな横顔に出会える公演となりそうだ。 ESOエバーグリーン交響楽団 × エリック・ルー 台湾から世界へ ～エバーグリーン・グループの理念の先へ 今回ルーが共演するのは、台湾のエバーグリーン交響楽団。 その名から、緑のロゴとラインが印象的なエバー航空の機体を思い浮かべる人もいるだろう。オーケストラと航空会社は同じエバーグリーン・グループに属し、エバーグリーン響は創業者・張栄発が設立した基金会のもと、2002年に発足した。 世界的にも珍しい、民間財団が運営するプロ・オーケストラであり、草創期から《雨夜花》《望春風》などの台湾民謡を管弦楽で演奏してきた。その響きは、エバー航空が台湾へ到着する際の機内音楽にも用いられてきた。 同社の便を利用した人なら、知らず知らずのうちにエバーグリーン響の演奏に触れているかもしれない。台湾に根差しながら世界へ向かうという理念を、まさに音で体現してきた楽団なのだ。 エバーグリーン交響楽団（ESO） 2002年、財団法人張栄発基金会によって設立されたエバーグリーン交響楽団（ESO）は、台湾で唯一の民間財団所属のプロフェッショナル・オーケストラである。「台湾に根差し、世界を志向する」という明確なビジョンのもと、優れた音楽人材の育成と、質の高いクラシック音楽の普及を使命としている。これまでにパヴァロッティ、ドミンゴ、カレラスの「世界三大テノール」をはじめ、アンドレア・ボチェッリ、ルネ・フレミング、ラン・ラン、チョーリャン・リン（林昭亮）など、世界的な巨匠たちと数多くの共演を重ねている。2025年1月からは世界的指揮者ヤープ・ヴァン・ズヴェーデンをアーティスト・イン・レジデンスに招聘し、2026年7月に東京・新潟公演を果たす。2026年以降もさらなる国際的展開を見据え、その活動の幅を広げ続けている。 筆者は今年3月、台北でエバーグリーン響のベートーヴェン《第九》を、7月には東京でマーラーの《子供の不思議な角笛》と交響曲第1番《巨人》を聴いた。 耳を捉えたのは、艶と厚みのある弦、各声部が明晰に噛み合う合奏力、そして、頂点へ向けてエネルギーを幾重にも積み上げる推進力だった。大編成が力を解放しても響きは鈍重にならず、音楽は筋肉質な輪郭を保って前進する。 一方、7月のマーラーでは、弦の上に独奏楽器が鮮やかに浮かび、精度の奥から、奏者たちの自発的な歌が聴こえてきた。 今年7月には東京と新潟でマーラーを聴かせたズヴェーデン＆エバーグリーン響 エバーグリーン響を「アジアの宝石」に ～ズヴェーデンの音楽づくり エバーグリーン響に変化をもたらしているのが、2025年からアーティスト・イン・レジデンスを務めるヤープ・ヴァン・ズヴェーデンである。 ロイヤル・コンセルトヘボウ管弦楽団のコンサートマスターから指揮者へ転じ、ダラス響、香港フィル、ニューヨーク・フィルを率いてきた。現在はソウル・フィルとフランス放送フィルの音楽監督を務めている。 ズヴェーデンの音楽づくりは精密で、ストイックだ。 速いテンポでも細部を曖昧にせず、リズムに強い芯を通し、声部の陰影を浮かび上がらせる。しかし、整然としているだけではなく、力強いグルーヴと、クライマックスへ向かって蓄積される熱を備えている。優れたヴァイオリン奏者としてオーケストラの内側を知る彼だけに、協奏曲でも独奏者を支えるだけでなく、ときに刺激し、ときにすっと引く立体的な対話が期待できる。 3月、台北で本人に取材した際、彼はエバーグリーン響を「アジアの宝石」に育てたいと語った。7月の東京・新潟公演からわずか3か月。今回の再来日公演は、その共同作業の現在地を確かめる絶好の機会である。 ヤープ・ヴァン・ズヴェーデン（指揮） 1960年アムステルダム生まれ。19歳でロイヤル・コンセルトヘボウ管弦楽団の史上最年少コンサートマスターに就任。1996年に指揮者へ転身し、オランダ放送フィルハーモニー管弦楽団首席指揮者（2005-2013／現在は名誉首席指揮者）、ダラス交響楽団音楽監督（2008-2018）、ニューヨーク・フィルハーモニック第26代音楽監督（2018-2024）を歴任した。現在、ニューヨーク・フィルハーモニックの音楽監督として2022年にデヴィッド・ゲフィン・ホールの歴史的な改修と再オープンを主導したほか、香港フィルハーモニー管弦楽団を国際的な地位へと押し上げ、ダラス交響楽団を全米屈指のアンサンブルへと成長させた。2024年からはソウル・フィルハーモニー管弦楽団の音楽監督に就任し、2025年からは台湾のエバーグリーン交響楽団のアーティスト・イン・レジデンス、そして2026年秋にはフランス放送フィルハーモニー管弦楽団の音楽監督への就任が決定している。オーケストラに対して明確な「ビジョンを聴き」、それを具現化する「マスター・ビルダー（名建築家）」と評される指揮者である。その卓越した芸術性は、彼が率いてきた数々の楽団を輝かしい成功へと導いてきた。 三者を味わうにふさわしい一夜 プログラムは、ラヴェル《ラ・ヴァルス》、チャイコフスキーのピアノ協奏曲、ショスタコーヴィチの交響曲第5番。この3曲は、エバーグリーン響とヴァン・ズヴェーデンの異なる表情を引き出す。 《ラ・ヴァルス》では、霧の中から姿を現す舞踏の色彩と、崩壊へ突き進む加速。チャイコフスキーでは、独奏者ルーとの緊密な対話。そして、ショスタコーヴィチでは、悲嘆、諧謔、行進、祈りがせめぎ合う巨大な構造を統御し、その多面性を描き分ける力が問われる。三者の持ち味を一夜でたっぷりと味わえる選曲だ。 精密な造形と強烈な推進力を併せ持つズヴェーデン、変貌のただ中にあるエバーグリーン響、そして、音の奥深くへ耳を澄ますエリック・ルー。 三者の個性が出会うとき、名曲の「煌めきの奥」から何が現れるのか。10月28日（水）は大阪・ザ・シンフォニーホール、30日（金）は京都コンサートホールで、その瞬間を確かめたい。 ESOエバーグリーン交響楽団 × エリック・ルー 公演情報 ESOエバーグリーン交響楽団 × エリック・ルー 大阪公演： 2026年10月28日（水）19:00開演／ザ・シンフォニーホール 京都公演： 2026年10月30日（金）19:00開演／京都コンサートホール 大ホール 出演： エバーグリーン交響楽団、ヤープ・ヴァン・ズヴェーデン（指揮）、エリック・ルー（ピアノ） プログラム： ラヴェル：ラ・ヴァルス チャイコフスキー：ピアノ協奏曲 第1番 変ロ短調 作品23 items.body: 会期：2026/08/05 会場：京都芸術センター 講堂［京都府］ 公式サイト：https://www.kac.or.jp/events/260805/ 振付（家）と権力構造。振付を「ナンセンスなゲームのルールの恣意性」へと還元する自己批判。スペクタクルとして消費される身体からの逃走。バレエという制度が内包するダンサーのヒエラルキー、さらには訓練されたプロのダンサー／アマチュアや子ども、障害者といった出演者のヒエラルキーの解体。「ダンスとは何か」について脱構築するようなコンセプチュアルな作品を制作してきたフランスの振付家ジェローム・ベル。自身の名前をタイトルに冠した本作『ジェローム・ベル』は、約30年に渡る振付家としてのキャリアと人生を振り返り、映像を見せながら自作について解説し、創作の背後にあるダンスや社会への問いを語る、2時間のレクチャー・パフォーマンスである。また、2019年以降は、環境負荷への配慮から、ベルと彼のカンパニーは飛行機での移動を行なわず、上演地ごとに、現地のパフォーマーがその土地の言葉で演じる形を採っている。日本版では、2025年の YPAMでの上演と同様、川口隆夫が「ジェローム・ベル」として出演する。「他者による代演」というもうひとつの仕掛けについては後編で詳述し、まずは本作で語られるベルの思索の軌跡を概観してみよう。 10代後半で国立ダンス学校に進学するも、従順なダンサーの養成機関にすぎないことへの失望。「踊らない」ダンサーの演劇的な仕草で観客に感銘を与えることができるピナ・バウシュの舞台に力づけられたこと。当時の1980年代は、ミッテラン大統領の進歩的な左派政権下でダンスに対する国家的支援が拡充され、コンテンポラリー・ダンスが盛行した。海外ツアーにも多く参加し、ダンサーとして華やかな経歴だったが、親友2人をエイズで亡くし、「人生で何をやりたいのか」という問いに直面したことから、振付家になろうと決心する。 ここでベルが特異なのは、振付家になるための修行期間として、2年間、美術史、文学、哲学などの読書に専念したことだ。その際、「アート」「文学」という言葉を「ダンス」に置き換えて読む。例えば、ロラン・バルトの『零度のエクリチュール』を「零度のダンス」に置換し、「ダンス」を問い直す思考のフレームを鍛える。また、ギー・ドゥボールの『スペクタクルの社会』に触発され、消費者の目を惹きつけるためにメディアが誇張する（性的）魅力に溢れた身体表象を批評するため、ダンスの媒体（メディウム）である身体を即物的な次元で扱う。本作と同じタイトルで発表された初期作『ジェローム・ベル』（1995）では、全裸のダンサーが、初めて触るものであるかのように自分自身の皮膚をつまみ、限界を確かめるようにゆっくりと皮を伸ばすシーンが紹介される。また、衝撃的なのが、舞台のみならず、日常的な社会規範からも「身体を解放」するために、ダンサーが放尿するシーンだ。全裸のダンサーは不動のまま、身体の内部にあったものが外に放出され、重力によって落下する運動が提示される。 観客の拒絶や批評家の酷評にもめげず、ベルはさらにラディカルな創作を進めていく。代表作のひとつ『The Show Must Go On』（2001）では、スペクタクルの消費社会と振付という権力への自己批評を展開。世界的にヒットしたポップ・ソングの歌詞を「振付のスコア」と捉え、特定の歌詞が流れた時だけ、ダンサーは歌詞が指示する行為を行なう。例えば、デヴィッド・ボウイの「レッツ・ダンス」がかかると、「レッツ・ダンス」と歌われるサビの間だけ、出演者はクラブ風の踊りを繰り返すが、それ以外は棒立ちの異様な時間が続く。ポリスの「見つめていたい」が流れると、出演者は舞台前面に一列に並び、客席を黙って凝視する。高尚なダンス／ポップ・カルチャーというヒエラルキーや、「見る／見られる」の非対称性の解体と同時に、ムーブメントの審美性や高度なテクニックが排除され、「振付とは、身体に課されたゲームのルールにすぎない」という恣意性や権力性が露わになる。 また、ベルは2000年代以降、パリ・オペラ座バレエ団からの依頼（！）を契機に、ダンサー自身が実演を交えて自伝を語る「ドキュメンタリー・ポートレート」のシリーズに取り組む。アマゾンの先住民の部族をフィールドワークしたクロード・レヴィ＝ストロースの文化人類学を参照し、「バレエという未知の体系」が研究対象にされた。調査サンプルとして起用されたのが、バレリーナのヴェロニク・ドワノーだ。バレエ団のヒエラルキーでは中間に位置するドワノーは、主役のエトワールを引き立てるために舞台美術のように静止する時間が最も辛いと語り、群舞と静止を行き来するシーンを実演してみせる。『白鳥の湖』の優美な音楽が覆い隠していたのは、ダンサーを非人間的な部品に変えるバレエの階級制度と、その基盤にある国家権力（絶対王政期に設立された王立ダンスアカデミー）だ。 ［Documentation Team © 2026 Hot Summer in Kyoto］ 2010年に入ると、ベルは、知的障害者の団体から依頼され、「言葉で表現することが難しい出演者とともに、人間性を疎外せず、どう創作できるか」という困難な問いに向き合う。『The Show Must Go On』のメソッドを応用しつつ、「出演者が自分の好きな曲を選び、自身のソロを作って踊る」という委ね方を選択した。踊りに熱中する出演者たちのパワーに圧倒され、「今、ここ」を生きている身体ほど舞台においてパワフルなものはないと語るベルは、『Disabled Theater』というタイトルとは裏腹に、この作品では、振付家という特権性からの解放、社会規範を解除する場として立ち上がる舞台、そして社会で周縁化された存在に表現力という力と武器を与えるものであったと振り返る。 『Disabled Theater』は高く評価されたが、「一人ひとり違うはずなのに、知的障害者としてひとくくりにされてしまう」という反省から、車椅子ユーザー、子ども、クィア、移民、定年退職者などより多様な出演者とともに、同じ手法でつくり上げたのが『Gala』（2015）である。また、『Disabled Theater』では、中央でソロを踊る出演者を、他の出演者が椅子に座って見つめるという構造だったが、『Gala』では、ソロの踊り手の動きを真似して他の出演者も一緒に踊ることにより、ソロ／群舞という境界も流動化させた。「それぞれが個でありながらどう平等でいられるか」という複雑な方程式をダンスで解くことの喜びがあったとベルは語る。 そして、イサドラ・ダンカンの自伝を元に彼女についての伝記的な作品をつくったことを契機に、ベルは、自身について語るこの作品『ジェローム・ベル』をつくるに至ったと語る。ダンスをめぐるラディカルな思索が2時間に凝縮された本作はそれだけでも十分に面白いのだが、さらにもうひとつの仕掛けが加算される。ここまで「ベルは」という主語で述べてきたが、実際に本上演で「ジェローム・ベル」として登場するのは、本人ではなく、川口隆夫という日本人のパフォーマーが日本語で語る。直接的な契機は気候変動対策であるとベルは述べるが、「本人ではない他者が振付家の自伝を語る」という構造は、「振付」それ自体についてのさらなる問いを推し進める。それは同時に、ダンス（舞台芸術）の反復性・再現可能性や、映像アーカイブと舞台芸術の一回性の問題についても問う作業になるだろう。 鑑賞日：2026/08/05（水） 関連レビュー 越智雄磨『コンテンポラリー・ダンスの現在──ノン・ダンス以後の地平』｜高嶋慈：artscapeレビュー（2020年07月15日号） 未だ見ぬ身体へ──川口隆夫『大野一雄について』｜岡村恵子：フォーカス（2017年11月15日号） ジェローム・ベル『ザ・ショー・マスト・ゴー・オン』（The Show Must Go On）｜木村覚：artscapeレビュー（2011年12月01日号） （後編へ）※10/5公開予定

items._cn_summary: 本文并非音乐作品乐评，而是关于法国振付家杰罗姆·贝尔的舞蹈公演《杰罗姆·贝尔》的观演纪实与作品概览。贝尔的创作路径围绕对舞蹈媒介的身体性、权力结构与等级制度的持续解构：早期作品以全裸、放尿等极端手段质疑身体再现的消费逻辑；《The Show Must Go On》将流行歌曲歌词当作振付评分，瓦解舞蹈美学与观看权力关系；巴黎歌剧院芭蕾委托作品以人类学田野调查的方式审视芭蕾等级制度背后的国家权力；《Disabled Theater》与《Gala》则将创作权交予智障人士、轮椅使用者、孩童、酷儿、退休者等多元群体，通过委派每人选择歌曲并编创独舞的方式，探索个体性与平等性并存的舞台可能性。京都公演由川口隆夫以日语代演。本文内容为公演活动报道与作品概述，文章在文末截断。

items.body: The Fat White / Decius frontman has announced his second book, Tears Of The Patriarch; we're delighted to present an extract from it. Portrait: Brian David Stevens. Other photographs: Yaz Saoudi Tears Of The Patriarch is Lias Saoudi's second book, due to be published by White Rabbit early next year. In 2014 Lias and his brother Yaz travelled to North Africa to recreate the 'Bittersweet Symphony' for an experimental Fat White Family single about circumcision. Which was all fun and games until the pair ended up in Algerian jail... All these bands speaking in regional accents instead of singing, it vexed me. Vexed me because I have no region. Vexed me because it seemed like a cult of authenticity, a provincial fetish... The post Today You Become Man, New Writing by Lias Saoudi appeared first on The Quietus.

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — Formed in 1997 from the ashes of Violet District?making it one of the oldest active neo-prog bands today? RPWL started out as a simple Pink Floyd tribute band but quickly managed to branch out?without betraying that influence?finding, as early as the album *God Has Failed* (2000), a sound and style all its own that has endured to this day, with just a few stylistic variations. Musically, *Crime Scene* doesn't shake things up. To our great delight, we find Yogi Lang's hazy melodies sung languidly in his velvety voice, and Kalle Wallner's majestic guitar, as determined as ever to deliver his beautiful Floydian solos that soar and glide along a thread suspended in the sky. All of this has always played a major role in the addictive charm of this timeless music. The absence of keyboardist Markus Jehle is the only notable change in this regard, leaving the spotlight entirely to Yogi Lang and his synthesizers?which are a bit more subdued than usual, though he doesn't forget to treat us, toward the end of the album, to his unchanging and unmissable Mini-Moog solo in the purest spirit of Manfred Mann's MMEB era. Certain tracks on *Crime Scene*, however, offer some welcome surprises, such as the lively intro to the brilliant and powerful "Victim of Desire," which is closer in style to Yes than to Pink Floyd. And the touch of '60s psychedelia on "A Cold Spring Day in '22." The heavy, offbeat riff?bordering on stoner rock?in "Another Life Beyond Control" also stands out in an album that some might find a little too polished. "King of the World" (12:51) is the album's pi�ce de r�sistance, unusually long for the band, which allows it?without any lulls, on a rhythm section once again closer to Yes than to Pink Floyd?to traverse a whole range of musical emotions worthy of the golden age of '70s prog, against a backdrop of Mellotron evoking the gloomy moods of our youth, when we walked with our heads down and raised them only to implore the heavens to restore our childlike carefreeness. Where the Bavarians are most surprising is in the theme?anything but trivial?chosen for their eighth studio album. The memorable *Tales from Outer Space* (2019) imagined that salvation for our species would come from space. After the interstellar journey comes a plunge into the deep night of the human soul to shed light on its most violent aspects. As its title makes quite clear, *Crime Scene* doesn't offer a selection of fairy tales for young children but instead sets out to recount a series of edifying stories. Starting with the dark "Victim of Desire," a veritable encounter with a nightmare, A disturbing news item that might provoke a sense of unease in the most sensitive among us, as if certain symptoms of some kind of post-traumatic neurosis?one we might be suffering from without even knowing it?were resurfacing. Through a story as sad as the sun's permanent absence, the bluesy "Red Rose" attempts to show us just how far mad love can lead. The catchy and effective "A Cold Spring Day in '22" in turn tells us another deeply grim story of a decimated family. It's a masterclass in the art of contrast between music and lyrics. Violence in our society?violence committed by human beings against one another, self-destructive and unnatural?has it not been present since the dawn of time, ever since this species came to be called "human"? Violence is everywhere?all around us and within each of us. But above all, *Crime Scene*, as a mirror reflecting the sickening prevalence of all violence against women perpetrated by men, presents us with an image that leaves no one indifferent. We may feel very distant from the dramatic situations depicted here?more or less graphically?and yet at the same time feel entirely affected. Are we all potential victims? And are we all potential monsters? Through six disturbing stories, curiously set to pleasant, harmonious melodies?music that is relatively peaceful by comparison?RPWL attempts, with *Crime Scene*, to offer an objective perspective that sends a chill down your spine.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是RPWL乐队的第八张录音室作品，整体延续乐队自2000年以来的neo-prog路线，核心音色以Yogi Lang慵懒的人声、Kalle Wallner的Floyd式吉他独奏和合成器为基础，键盘手Markus Jehle的缺席使编曲更聚焦于主创的双人对话。部分曲目引入Yes风格节奏段落、六十年代迷幻元素以及接近stoner rock的偏重失真riff，在精致基调上加入变化。主题上从前作的外太空救赎转向人类灵魂深处的暴力面，以叙事化的歌词串联多首歌曲。12分钟的"King of the World"是专辑核心长篇，以Mellotron铺陈氛围，跨越多种情绪层次。音乐本质上属于对七十年代prog黄金时代的致敬与延续，并未突破既有范式，与用户偏好的实验、前卫、爵士、电子等方向相距较远。

items.body: Review by kenethlevine — An unfortunate fate of some artists of the 1970s lies in the rapid evolution of "popular" music of that time. A band conceived in the early 1970s, formed in the mid 1970s, and finally committing their sound to new generations, even if mostly within their own family tree, in the late 1970s would be behind the times from the outset. In the case of Finnish chameleons KAAMOS, it might not have mattered since their sole release wouldn't have been original 5 years earlier, but in 1978 it was so distinctly undistinguished as to almost be innovative, but no. A pastiche of palettes from the late 1960s and early 1970s, mostly in a heavy rock vein with brushes of folk and blues, it recalls pretty much every band that was at least critically fashionable at that time, including WIGWAM which didn't sound particularly Finnish either. The playing is very competent, especially the lead guitars, organs and rhythm section, but, while they were clearly familiar with each other, I can't help feeling it's all a bit too democratic. Best deeds here would be the wildly but admirably mercurial "Strife" and the engaging instrumental "Barokki", but they can only save this one from complete ignominy.
items._genre: progressive folk / heavy rock / blues rock
items._cn_summary: 芬兰乐队KAAMOS于1977年发行的唯一专辑《Deeds and Talks》将七十年代前期的摇滚语汇——厚重吉他、键盘与节奏段落——与民谣、布鲁斯元素混融，试图在渐进摇滚框架内拓展色彩层次。乐评指出乐队演奏技术扎实，吉他与管风琴的配合尤其成熟，但整体风格过于折衷民主，缺乏鲜明个性，作品风格在问世时已被视为过时。专辑中较为突出的两首作品——《Strife》展现出多变的气质，《Barokki》作为器乐曲具有一定吸引力，但难以扭转整张专辑的平庸印象。这是一张带有年代感与地域色彩（芬兰）的渐进摇滚作品，对偏好实验前卫或电子融合的听众来说风格距离较远。

items.body: Belgian electronic dance act Lords Of Acid release their new album “Mundo Bizarro” digitally on 15 October 2026 via Metropolis Records. LP and CD formats follow on 9 November. The album is the group’s first collection of new material since 2018’s “Pretty in Kink”. “Mundo Bizarro” gathers the four singles Lords Of Acid have issued since April 2026, Karaoke Superstar (featuring Princess Superstar), Dream Boy (featuring Carla Harvey), “El Mundo Está Loco” (featuring Tony & The Kiki) and Ich Will Nur Dass (featuring Mari Kattman), alongside seven further new songs. The full tracklist, confirmed via the band’s Bandcamp page, runs: “Dreamboy”, “Dancing on the Flames”, “El Mundo Está Loco”, “Dopamine War”, “Maximo Roboto”, “Ich Will Nur Dass”, “City of Angels”, “So Stoned Today”, “Karaoke Superstar”, “You’re Obscene” and “A Viking’s Heart”. Mundo Bizarro by Lords Of Acid Carla Harvey, formerly co-lead vocalist of the American heavy rock band Butcher Babies, joined Lords Of Acid in January 2025, succeeding the late Ruth McArdle. The digital release of “Mundo Bizarro” coincides with the second leg of Lords Of Acid’s Cheeky Freaky North American tour, first announced in February 2026. At that time, the album carried the working title “Acid Reign”. The September 2026 press release from Metropolis Records confirms the final title as “Mundo Bizarro”. Specific October and November tour dates were not included in the current press materials. About Lords Of Acid Lords Of Acid formed in Antwerp, Belgium, in 1988, founded by Praga Khan together with Oliver Adams and Jade 4U. The group emerged from the hard-edged electronic dance scene of that era, blending techno, acid house and industrial music with lyrics centered on sexuality, drug use and hedonism. The band debuted with the New Beat single “I Sit on Acid”. Its first album, “Lust”, followed in 1991. “Voodoo-U”, with Ruth McArdle on vocals, arrived in 1994 and brought a heavier industrial dance sound along with the band’s best-known US club hits. “Our Little Secret” appeared in 1997. The B-side compilation “Heaven Is an Orgasm” (1998) and the remix album “Expand Your Head” (1999) came next. The rock-influenced “Farstucker”, featuring Deborah Ostrega, arrived in 2000. After a long gap, “Deep Chills” (2012) introduced Mea Fisher on vocals, and the Kickstarter-funded “Pretty in Kink” (2018) introduced Marieke Bresseleers. Metropolis Records remastered and reissued the band’s catalog from 2017 onward. Ruth McArdle died in 2024. Carla Harvey, previously of Butcher Babies, was announced as the band’s new lead vocalist in January 2025 and has since toured extensively with the group, including the 2025 “Praise The Lords” tour and the 2026 “Cheeky Freaky” tour. “Mundo Bizarro” is Harvey’s first full studio album with Lords Of Acid.

items.body: Ministry‘s “Moral Hygiene” turns 5 on 1 October. The industrial metal band released its fifteenth studio album through Nuclear Blast on 1 October 2021, produced by Al Jourgensen. The record runs ten tracks and 47 minutes, and it marked the first Ministry album since 2012’s “Relapse” to include a cover song. “Moral Hygiene” was recorded over roughly three years following 2018’s “AmeriKKKant” and is the first Ministry album to feature bassist Paul D’Amour, formerly of Tool, who joined the band in 2019. It is also the first record since 2006’s “Rio Grande Blood” without guitarist Sin Quirin, who left Ministry in March 2021. The album’s cover of Iggy Pop and James Williamson’s “Search and Destroy” was released as a single on 20 August 2021, alongside “Alert Level” (24 April 2020) and “Good Trouble” (8 July 2021), the latter accompanied by a “Unity Mix” the band put out to honor civil rights leader John Lewis. Guest musicians on “Moral Hygiene” include guitarist Billy Morrison, former Megadeth bassist David Ellefson, former N.W.A member Arabian Prince, and Jello Biafra, Jourgensen’s former bandmate in Lard, who takes lead vocals on “Sabotage Is Sex.” The album was engineered by Michael Rozon and mastered by Dave Donnelly. It was released on CD, vinyl, cassette and digital formats via Nuclear Blast. Moral Hygiene by Ministry About Ministry Ministry formed in Chicago in 1981 as the synthpop project of Al Jourgensen. The band’s 1983 debut, “With Sympathy,” was released through Arista Records and leaned toward the synth-driven sound of the era, a direction Jourgensen later disowned as label-imposed. Ministry’s sound shifted toward the aggressive, guitar-driven industrial style that would define the band starting with 1986’s “Twitch,” produced with Adrian Sherwood, and continuing through 1988’s “The Land of Rape and Honey” and 1989’s “The Mind Is a Terrible Thing to Taste,” both released on Sire Records. The band’s commercial breakthrough came with 1992’s “Psalm 69: The Way to Succeed and the Way to Suck Eggs,” which went platinum in the United States and included the single “Jesus Built My Hotrod” featuring Gibby Haynes of the Butthole Surfers. Ministry continued through the 1990s with “Filth Pig” (1996) and “Dark Side of the Spoon” (1999), then released “Animositisomina” (2003), the final album to feature longtime bassist Paul Barker, before Jourgensen turned to a trilogy of albums aimed at the George W. Bush administration: “Houses of the Molé” (2004), “Rio Grande Blood” (2006) and “The Last Sucker” (2007). Jourgensen announced Ministry’s retirement after “The Last Sucker,” then reactivated the band with 2012’s “Relapse,” recorded after he survived a near-fatal ruptured ulcer. Ministry has released albums steadily since, including “From Beer to Eternity” (2013), featuring posthumous contributions from guitarist Mike Scaccia, “AmeriKKKant” (2018), “Moral Hygiene” (2021) and “Hopiumforthemasses” (2024), each addressing the political landscape of its release year. Jourgensen remains the band’s sole constant member, working alongside a rotating cast of musicians including longtime guitarist Cesar Soto and, since 2019, bassist Paul D’Amour. “Moral Hygiene” extended that run five years ago this October, arriving as Ministry’s fifteenth studio album.
items._cn_summary: 本文并非乐评，而是Ministry乐队2021年专辑《Moral Hygiene》发行五周年的资讯回顾。文章以编年史方式列举了专辑的制作人Al Jourgensen、录制周期、客座乐手及单曲发行日期等基本事实，并附带了乐队自1981年成立以来的历史脉络，包括从Synthpop转向工业金属的过程以及商业巅峰期。该专辑是乐队的第十五张录音室专辑，包含一首Iggy Pop翻唱曲，延续了乐队以政治批判和社会评论为主题的创作路线，但文章本身未涉及任何音乐性分析或艺术评价，与深度乐评相距甚远。

items.body: ジャズ・ピアニストの海野雅威が、10月16日（金）に東京・有楽町の I’M A SHOWでライブ「Tribute to OSCAR PETERSON “We Get Requests revisited” presented by 海野雅威」を開催。楠井五月（b）、後藤龍太郎（ds）とのトリオで、オスカー・ピーターソンが1964年に発表した名盤『We Get Requests』（邦題：プリーズ・リクエスト）をテーマにステージを繰り広げる。 海野にとってピーターソンは、音楽人生の原点といえる存在だ。9歳の時に来日公演で聴いた、圧倒的なスウィング感にあふれる演奏に魅了されたことが、ジャズ・ピアニストを志す大きなきっかけになったという。本公演では、オリジナル・アルバムへの敬意を込めながら、海野ならではの解釈で名盤の魅力を新たな形で表現する。 公演に向けて海野は「9歳の頃にライブで聴いたオスカー・ピーターソン。今でも心に残るあたたかなライブでジャズの魅力に目覚め人生が変わりました」とコメント。さらに、その公演でピーターソンのドラマーを務めていたのがジェフ・ハミルトンだったことに触れ、35年を経て自身がハミルトンのトリオで世界を巡っている現在を「これもきっとオスカーが繋いでくれた縁でしょう」と語る。誕生日がピーターソンと同じであることも、子供の頃からの自慢だという。 当日は、海野がピーターソンを好きになった当時からよく聴いていた『We Get Requests』の楽曲を中心に披露する予定。昨年、生誕100周年を迎えた巨匠に想いを馳せる一夜となりそうだ。 【公演情報】 Tribute to OSCAR PETERSON “We Get Requests revisited” presented by 海野雅威 日時：2026年10月16日（金）開場18:15／開演19:00 会場：I’M A SHOW（東京都千代田区有楽町2-5-1 有楽町マリオン別館7F） 出演：海野雅威トリオ／海野雅威（p）、楠井五月（b）、後藤龍太郎（ds） 料金：全席指定8,200円（税込）※入場時ドリンク代600円別途必要／未就学児入場不可 チケット：チケットぴあ（Pコード：333-678）、イープラス、ローソンチケット（Lコード：75035）、チケットサンライズ（0570-077-020）ほかで発売中 投稿 海野雅威がオスカー・ピーターソンの名盤『We Get Requests』に捧げるトリビュート公演を開催 は ARBAN に最初に表示されました。
items._cn_summary: 本文为日本爵士钢琴家海野雅威向Oscar Peterson经典专辑《We Get Requests》致敬的演出活动新闻稿。海野以钢琴三重奏形式（钢琴、贝斯、鼓），重现1964年那张名盘中的曲目，并融入个人化的演绎。文章着重介绍海野与Peterson的渊源——九岁时观看其来日演出后立志成为爵士钢琴家，如今又与当年Peterson乐团的鼓手Jeff Hamilton同台巡演，颇具传承意味。演出信息完备，涵盖日期、场地、票价及购票渠道。整体而言，这是一篇标准的演出宣传稿，侧重情怀叙事而非音乐分析或创新性探讨，风格偏向传统主流爵士领域，缺乏实验性或跨界融合元素。

items.body: 目次 今こそ〈横溝音楽〉を聴こう 大野雄二が市川崑と衝突しながら作り上げた「犬神家の一族」の音楽 日本的叙情が織り込まれた芥川也寸志による「八つ墓村」の劇伴 横溝正史本人が公認、〈日本のレアグルーヴ〉作品として注目を集める企画盤 〈横溝正史〉を知ると音楽の聴こえ方も変わってくる タワーレコード新宿店～渋谷店の洋楽ロック／ポップス担当として、長年にわたり数々の企画やバイイングを行ってきた北爪啓之さんによる連載〈聴いたことのない旧譜は新譜〉。そのタイトル通り、本連載では旧譜と称されてしまった作品を現在の耳で新譜として紹介していきます。 第17回は、横溝正史原作の映像作品の音楽について大特集。現在公開中の清水崇監督による映画「八つ墓村」が話題のなか、大野雄二や芥川也寸志らが手がけた名スコアを北爪さんが再考します。 ＊Mikiki編集部 ★連載〈聴いたことのない旧譜は新譜〉の記事一覧はこちら 今こそ〈横溝音楽〉を聴こう 2026年の9月は、横溝正史ファンにとってじつに賑やかで記念すべき月となった。まず18日には「呪怨」などで名高いJホラーの旗手、清水崇が監督を務めた映画「八つ墓村」が封切られた。約20年ぶりとなる久々の横溝原作の映画化ということもあり、毀誉褒貶が入り乱れつつも大きな話題を呼んでいる。 また、16日には1977年に製作された野村芳太郎監督による「八つ墓村」の4Kデジタル修復版の映像ソフトが発売。さらに30日には、1976年の市川崑監督版「犬神家の一族」のサントラ盤がアナログLPフォーマットで正規再発された。なお同作はちょうど50年（半世紀!）前の10月16日に公開されている。 そこで今回はこの時ならぬ横溝ブームの再燃に乗じて、いまでもタワーレコード オンラインで購入可能な関連作品を紹介してみたい。すでに廃盤や生産中止になってしまったものも多いため、現在流通しているアルバムはおそらく3タイトルしかないのだが、そのどれもが2026年のいま〈横溝音楽〉を紐解くための最良のテキストとなるべき作品ばかりである。 大野雄二が市川崑と衝突しながら作り上げた「犬神家の一族」の音楽
items._cn_summary: 本文为日本推理作家横沟正史影视改编作品的原声音乐企划介绍，主要涉及大野雄二为市川崑版《犬神家的一族》创作的配乐以及芥川也寸志为《八つ墓村》打造的剧伴。这些作品诞生于1970年代日本电影黄金期，带有浓厚的日式悬疑氛围和传统器乐色彩，偶有被乐迷视为日本产稀有放克/灵魂乐素材。文章以回顾式乐评为主，兼具影视资讯性质，讨论电影配乐与导演之间的创作碰撞。文章并非原创深度乐评，更接近于企划盘推荐与旧谱再介绍的内容，且涉及的音乐类型偏向传统管弦配乐，与实验、前卫、电子等方向关联有限。

items._cn_summary: 这是一期RootsWorld Radio播客节目Race The Sky #026，由Cliff Furnald主持。内容并非专辑乐评，而是一档混搭式电台节目，汇集了多位风格迥异的音乐人，包括David Bowie、Cream等西方经典艺人，以及Dawda Jobarteh、Eneida Marta、Issa Murad等来自非洲、中东、欧洲等地的世界音乐艺术家。节目自称'Wicky Whacky Back Pages'，强调不拘一格的选曲逻辑，每隔几分钟就会切换风格。整体呈现为一档跨度极大的杂锦式电台节目，缺乏统一的艺术概念或深度评论，适合作为背景音乐发现新曲目，但难以满足对实验性、前卫性或系统性音乐探索有较高要求的听众。内容为节目预告/简介性质，正文极短，信息量有限。

items._cn_summary: RootsWorld Radio的一期节目，以河流与沼泽为主题，汇集了多位来自不同国家和传统的音乐人作品。节目涉及Dr. John、Jake Blount、Eric Bibb、Pete Seeger等美国根源音乐与民谣艺人，也收入了来自芬兰（Maria Kalaniemi & Pekko Käppi）、西非（Saly Kouyate）、希腊（Martha Mavroidi）、法国（Compagnie Chez Bousca）等地的世界音乐曲目，以及Jean-Luc Thomas四重奏等爵士即兴内容。整体编排呈现跨文化的音乐拼贴，涵盖民间谣曲、布鲁斯与传统器乐。然而该节目本质是电台播放列表式的罗列，并非具有深度艺术评论或创新概念的乐评文本，缺少对音乐制作、编曲或艺术取向的分析论述，信息密度较低，难以体现实验性或前卫性视角。
